description: This file implements the Probe class and related functionality for a network discovery plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for handling discovery messages, processing SSDP-like requests, generating responses, and managing network communication for device discovery.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: A helper class representing discovery messages and responses, encapsulating various constructors for different discovery scenarios and providing access to the message data and length.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming SSDP-like requests, manages discovery responses, and maintains state related to network nodes and requests.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles incoming responses from network devices, validates responses, and reports discovered devices.

methods.name: Probe::WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Processes incoming Web requests to identify M-SEARCH messages and deserializes them if matched.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to incoming requests.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Received
methods.description: Handles incoming discovery requests, validates them, and queues responses.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Send
methods.description: Sends responses to discovery requests and manages the queue of pending responses.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::ValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the authenticity of incoming requests, including signature verification if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a response message with latency and model information, optionally signing it if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming response data, validates it, and reports discovered devices.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ValidResponse
methods.description: Validates the integrity and authenticity of responses.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Records a discovered device with its URL, latency, model, and security status.
